title: My Dearest Senorita
writer: Jaime de Armiñán, José Luis Borau
actors: José Luis López Vázquez, Julieta Serrano, Antonio Ferrandis
plot: A 43-year-old woman living in a small town discovers that she is actually a man. Will she change her sex and suffer the reaction of a narrow-minded society?
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 8 wins & 3 nominations total
